title: Single-shot and agentic retrieval with Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base
headline: Single-shot and agentic retrieval with Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base
ai_overview: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports single-shot RAG and retrieval-only requests through AgenticRetrieveStream, alongside agentic retrieval. This post explains how the maxAgentIteration parameter matches retrieval effort to each request, using an illustrative internal banking policy assistant.
